gaps: The draft's policy period is internally inconsistent (2025–2030 versus 2025–2035); adoption and numerical source dates need human confirmation.
Shelter GBV is a stated protection risk, not observed incidence or evidence of armed conflict. Administrative procurement and coordination barriers are not attributed to insecurity.

executive_assessment.text: Named parish poverty and sister-island water dependence help distinguish vulnerability within Grenada; the underlying indicators are historical or undated.
The draft highlights shelter protection risks. NAWASA's October 2026 report provides named-site water investments, with operational work and outcome verification still outstanding.
